scientific_integrity: All bounds are established analytically for all bounded bilateral trajectories. Computational tests are finite checks, not an independent proof. The claim is not a new result about the existence of chaotic Griffiths phases.
scientific_limitations: Requires global all-to-all averaging, k_min>0, 0<=a<1, b>0, and (1-epsilon)L<1. Conservative sufficient coupling; nonlinear longitudinal dynamics, sparse graphs, and behavior at intermediate coupling are unclassified. Historical priority has not undergone independent assessment.
title: Uniform quenched-disorder profile on the complete attractor of strongly coupled Chialvo maps
